    14  We define an algebra map from `ℂ[X]` to the `MeasureTheory.Lp` (with `p := 2`) space on the additive
    15  circle and show that it sends monomials to the Fourier basis. From this, we derive that polynomial
    16  coefficients match Fourier coefficients and prove Parseval's identity for polynomials.
    17

    19  
    20  - `Polynomial.toAddCircle`: Algebra map from `ℂ[X]` to `C(AddCircle (2 * π), ℂ)` that evaluates

    22

    24  
    25  - `Polynomial.fourierCoeff_toAddCircle`: The `n`-th Fourier coefficient of a polynomial
    26    equals its `n`-th coefficient when `n` is nonnegative, else 0.
